answer.summary: API Types Check fails deterministically: the regenerated api-types.d.ts drops PayloadCustomizationUpdateOutput.update_other_changes, so the committed front-end types are stale against the changed Java DTO. Regenerate with 'yarn generate-types-from-api' and commit the result; a rerun will fail the same way.

evidence.quote: ⚠️ Forgot to generate types! Please run 'yarn run generate-types-from-api' before committing.
